Let the cost of each of the other two pizzas be $ x $.

We know the total cost of all four pizzas is $ 64 $ dollars, and two of the pizzas cost $ 30 $ dollars each.

So, the cost of the other two pizzas is $ 64 - 30 - 30 = 4 $ dollars.

Therefore, each of the other two pizzas cost $ 4 $ dollars.

FINAL_ANSWER: 4
